services.name: Room Of Choice Delivery
services.description: The delivery team will deliver the item to the customer’s home or designated location. The delivery team will move the item safely, protect the home, and place it where the customer requests within the allowed service level. This service does not include install, uninstall, assemble, or haul away items unless those services are included on the order.

services.name: Unpack
services.description: The delivery team will unbox the item and remove outer packaging as instructed. The delivery team will check the item for visible damage, stage it where the order directs, and leave packaging where instructed. This service does not include install, assemble, or haul away items unless those services are included on the order.

services.name: Remove Debris
services.description: The delivery team will remove and properly dispose of debris generated from delivery or installation, including cardboard, plastic wrap, foam, pallets, and other packaging materials. Area is left clean and free of loose trash.

This service does not include modify electrical, gas, plumbing, structural elements, or cabinets beyond what is listed on the order.

services.name: Fuel Surcharge (Quantity Enabled)

The fuel surcharge will be based on the price per gallon of diesel fuel stated by the U.S. Department of Energy in their weekly reports each Monday. The effective periods will be from Monday in the succeeding week through the next Sunday. Stop quantity recorded.
